description: Replace a post's image entirely. Pass imageUrl to swap in an existing image (instant), or prompt to generate a brand-new AI image (async ~1-2 min, applied automatically; check with get_task_status). When the new image shows the user or a named person, call use_character_reference first and pass its referenceImageUrls, or the image shows a stranger.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the replacement image

postId.description: The post whose image to replace

prompt.description: Description of a new image to AI-generate instead

referenceImageUrls.description: With prompt: identity photos of the person to show, from use_character_reference or supplied by the user

name: change_image
title: Change Image
